what: One story, one #launch clause and one criterion, planned: every agent pi-role launches, pane or headless, in any target, runs git through the kit's stash guard; in a repository with more than one worktree a git stash that adds, removes or replaces an entry is refused, naming a work-in-progress commit on the agent's own branch; reading the stash, other git commands and a one-worktree repository's stash run unchanged. Extends the one launch mechanism (pi-role's PATH placement, as for mise's shims), no new role, loop or template change.
why: Issue #1185 and the director's lane brief 2026-11-25: one agent's git stash must never take or drop another agent's work across worktrees, by structure and not a prose rule (docs/adr/0008). No spec states it. Design posted before code: #1185 issuecomment-7168239371 (git offers no per-worktree stash; a reference-transaction hook misses drop; a guard ref names no alternative).
evidence: git 2.43.0, scratch repo with two linked worktrees: git stash push -m 'lane1 wip' in w1, then git stash drop in w2 prints Dropped refs/stash@{0} and w1's git stash list is empty; both resolve git rev-parse --git-path refs/stash to the common dir's refs/stash. 2026-11-20 07:55:25Z implementer-gh1178 (session 670227c8) ran git stash -q; git stash apply -q; ... git stash drop -q in its lane worktree while the kit's stash held entries of five other lanes.

what: #launch-stash-guard: a git stash whose subcommand writes the stash is refused whatever its other arguments (fails closed); of such a subcommand only its help, -h or --help as its one argument, runs. Criterion unchanged: its refusal and kept entry stand; a write subcommand mixing options with a help word is refused rather than shown help.
why: Code review rounds 1 and 2 on PR #1309 (stash-guard-bypass twice, git-command-regression twice): telling a help request from an option value inside a write's arguments means re-implementing git 2.43's parse-options (abbreviated long options, attached and next-word values, --end-of-options), and each round found a new form that pushed through the guard or refused real help. Failing closed on any write subcommand removes that parser; the one cost is help shown for a write mixed with other options, which no recorded agent call uses.
evidence: Review round 2 (range dabf51ab..9ccde1b7): git stash push --mes --help and git stash save --end-of-options --help write refs/stash with pending changes while the guard at 9ccde1b7 passes them as help; git stash -mspam --help prints help (exit 129) in real git while the guard refuses it. Round 1 (https://github.com/0xTomDaniel/octo-feather/pull/1309#issuecomment-7170382887): git stash -m --help pushed through. Replay of 551 recorded agent stash calls (/tmp/gh1185/replay/full2.txt): none mixes a write subcommand's options with -h or --help.

what: #launch-stash-guard: the refused subcommands are those that can add, remove or replace an entry, so git stash export (git 2.51+), which can replace the stash's tip through --to-ref, is refused whatever its arguments, as import is; its --print form, which only prints, is refused with it rather than parsed apart. Criterion unchanged.
why: Code review round 4 on PR #1309 (stash-guard-bypass): git stash export --to-ref refs/stash passed the guard and replaced refs/stash (git 2.56.1). Telling a safe export from one whose destination resolves to refs/stash means parsing export's options and resolving its ref, the option grammar call 28751fbd removed; failing closed at the subcommand keeps that rule. No recorded agent call uses export.
evidence: Review round 4 (range 256d8c99..e816d8a2): through headless pi-role with real git 2.56.1 in two worktrees, git stash export --to-ref refs/stash exited 0 with no refusal and refs/stash moved acebfaac to 0ccbe7b6; git's builtin/stash.c 2409-2411 updates the given ref without excluding refs/stash. Replay of 551 recorded agent stash calls (/tmp/gh1185/stash_rows.json): none uses export or import.

what: #launch-stash-guard: the guard also holds for a test or script the agent runs that narrows PATH to a directory of its own holding a link to or a copy of the agent's git, the only git on it: git still runs and a stash write is still refused. One criterion, planned, acceptance-stash-guard-private-path: in that setup git status shows the worktree's status, git stash drop is refused naming a work-in-progress commit, and the entry stays. Extends the one launch mechanism (pi-role's launch, scripts/stash-guard), no second one.
why: Issue #1322 and the director's lane brief 2026-11-26: since the guard (PR #1309) every agent pi-role launches sees a red gate on main, because tests (the kit's and any target's) build a private bin dir from the git on PATH, which is the guard, and the guard then has no git to run. The spec named only the launch PATH, not a PATH a test narrows. Design approved by the director: #1322 issuecomment-7184502553.
evidence: Director's reproduction on main a9f9d842: PATH="$PWD/scripts/stash-guard:$PATH" bash tests/check-decision-log.sh exits 1 with 'git (kit stash guard /tmp/tmp.XXXX.bin/git): no git on PATH after this guard'; without the guard on PATH it exits 0. Lane gh1255 counted 15 red gate items under the guard (test_lane_tickets.py items, tests/check-decision-log.sh).

what: #launch-stash-guard: a stash write whose worktree count the guard cannot establish is refused; and the guard's stated limit: it stops an agent's routine stash from touching the shared stash, not a deliberate bypass (git run by absolute path, or a git the agent puts in place that misreports the worktrees). Criteria unchanged.
why: Code review rounds 1 and 2 on PR #1324 (stash-guard-bypass): round 1's failed-count authorization is fixed fail-closed (b2e6260a); round 2 found a planted git that lies about the worktree count still passes. Director ruling 2026-11-26: that is the absolute-path case with more steps, outside what the guard is for (honest agents' routine stash, the 20 Nov incident); a root-owned system git for the count would break targets whose git comes from mise, nix or Homebrew. The spec did not state the limit; the guard's header did only for absolute paths. Owner rules on the limit in the merge ask.
evidence: Review round 2 (range 2d6cc106..4fb788c9, https://github.com/0xTomDaniel/octo-feather/pull/1324#issuecomment-7186340840): through headless pi-role, a linked guard with python3 on the private PATH and a wrapper git that prints `worktree /fake` for worktree inventory and delegates the rest to /usr/bin/git, plain git stash drop exits 0 and empties the first worktree's stash, via OCTO_FEATHER_GIT and via the next git on PATH. Round 1: the same wrapper exiting 1 for worktree also dropped the entry (fixed in b2e6260a).
